The '''1935–36 Scottish Division One''' season was won by [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]] by five points over city rival [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]]. [[Airdrieonians F.C. (1878)|Airdrieonians]] and [[Ayr United F.C.|Ayr United]] finished 19th and 20th respectively and were relegated to the [[1936–37 Scottish Division Two]].
